wedo_instance.description: The metabolic bridge for Bulk Ingestion of remote intentions from multiple Pull Requests.

meta.philosophy: Conscious Duality: The shared thread of attention between Remote Intent (Rider) and Local Execution (Machinery).
meta.instruction: Scan ALL open PRs. Ingest every identified intent (e.g., 'WEDO' or '- [ ] WeDo:') into a consolidated instance of this file in the day's chrono-fractal.

protocols.name: Audit Scrutiny
protocols.rule: Every task must be granularly documented with its source PR URL and a forensic report of its localhost resolution.

protocols.name: Hostile Environment Verification
protocols.rule: The machinery MUST verify all artifacts on the localhost. Remote-only tasks must be flagged as USER_REQUIRED.

protocols.name: Bulk Ingestion
protocols.rule: Default to consolidating multiple PRs into a single session thread to minimize context-switching heat.

rules.accumulation: Word count must ALWAYS increase in each iteration.
rules.temporal_instance: Never work in global templates; copy to day's json/ directory.
rules.audit_scrutiny: List all changes/requests from source for verifiable history.
rules.active_investigation: Verify artifact existence on localhost before inclusion.
rules.dual_referencing: Reference both localhost paths and remotehost URLs.
rules.audit_trail_linking: Daily session WeDos MUST link to specific project WeDos to maintain a forensic audit trail.
rules.output_location: All active task instances and WeDo reports MUST reside in the day's temporal json/ directory.
rules.finalization_protocol: The goal is to refine 'md/wedo/' artifacts into permanent Heartwood in 'md/'. This transition (and renaming) occurs ONLY upon an explicit 'straightup' request from the user (HAM prompt).
rules.versioning_archival: When updating Markdown documents, always rename the previous version and move it to the local context/ directory (e.g., <AGENT>_<SESSION>_<NAME>_v<OLD>.md) before establishing the new version in the primary md/ location.
rules.rna_presumption: All raw session artifacts (WeDo instances, logs, intermediate reports) are considered 'RNA' and MUST reside in '.hidden/' subdirectories of their respective temporal or leaf folders.
rules.heartwood_expression: Only refined artifacts, approved for permanent inclusion by the user, are promoted from '.hidden/' to the parent leaf folder (e.g., md/ or json/) as 'DNA' (Heartwood).
rules.aspirational_filesystem: The filesystem structure reflects the agent's aspirations: '.hidden/' for process and survival, Leaf folders for legislative history and brilliance.

tasks.description: Bulk Scan: Fetch patches for all open PRs and identify active intentions.
OPERATOR SIGN-OFF: Present the consolidated summarized intentions for Human review. I CANNOT proceed until you explicitly approve the execution of specific WeDo IDs.
ID Assignment: Assign unique session-based WeDo IDs to approved tasks.
Localhost Execution: Perform the approved modifications on the sovereign filesystem.
Synthesis Report: Generate a unified Synthesis Report meeting the Audit Scrutiny standard.
